subject: website
name: James Beck
summary: James Beck's blog on ENS and consumer crypto, with music pages. No public source for this build was found. It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Google Tag Manager and Analytics from another host and embeds SoundCloud, Bandcamp and Nina players that load with the page, third-party code the user has not asked for.
